meta.event: Rasuwa–Bhote Koshi/Trishuli flash flood, 26 Aug 2026 (10 Bhadra 2083)
meta.disclaimer: Independently compiled from Nepali government notices, news reporting and a social-media-organized citizen relief effort. Not an official government source. Call ahead before traveling with a large donation — some points may wind down as needs shift.

centers.name: Bharatpur Metropolitan City Relief Collection Room
centers.note: Local collection point for Chitwan-area donors, separate from the Kathmandu/Nuwakot/Dhading chain. Exact address not independently verified — call ahead.

centers.name: Kathmandu District Administration Office (CDO), Babarmahal
centers.note: Organizations, companies and clubs running their own collection drives are asked to coordinate/hand over through this office. It ran 24-hour public intake in the days right after the flood before Samakhusi and Basundhara took over as the dedicated sites.

centers.name: District Coordination Committee Hall, Bidur
centers.note: Onward routing point inside Nuwakot for relief already collected in Kathmandu Valley. Exact GPS not confirmed.

centers.name: Bidur Municipality Office
centers.note: Onward routing point inside Nuwakot for relief already collected in Kathmandu Valley. Exact GPS not confirmed.

centers.name: District Administration Office, Dhunche
centers.note: Final-mile distribution point into the worst-hit district. Named in one official notice, not cross-confirmed elsewhere; no GPS.

centers.name: Tribhuvan International Airport – National Emergency Warehouse

nuwakot_holding_centers.note: These are not donor drop-off points for people in Kathmandu — they are on-the-ground redistribution sites inside Nuwakot where the local disaster committee stages relief for handout to survivors. Relevant only if you are already travelling to Nuwakot directly.
venues: Ranbhuwaneshwari Secondary School and Ward Office

other_ways_to_help.name: Nepal Red Cross Society
other_ways_to_help.note: Cash donations and volunteer coordination — 200+ staff already deployed with tarpaulins, blankets, sleeping mats, first aid kits and drinking water.

cash_donation.warning: Nepal Police have warned about fake QR codes circulating on social media claiming to collect for flood victims. Verify the payee name reads exactly “Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund” before scanning any QR.
cash_donation.note: Bank account numbers and live donation totals change daily and are deliberately left out here — use the official portal instead of a number shared on social media.
